# Hospio Solutions

> Hospio Solutions is a hospitality-focused digital marketing and commercial services partner based in Bali, Indonesia. The company supports hotels, resorts, villas and hospitality businesses in Bali, across Indonesia and internationally.

## Official Website

- [Hospio Solutions Homepage](https://www.hospiosolutions.com/)
- [Services](https://www.hospiosolutions.com/services.html)
- [About Hospio Solutions](https://www.hospiosolutions.com/about-us.html)
- [Contact](https://www.hospiosolutions.com/contact.html)
- [Blog and Insights](https://www.hospiosolutions.com/blog/)

## Services

Hospio Solutions provides digital marketing and commercial support for hospitality businesses, including:

- Commercial Partner support for hospitality businesses
- Digital marketing strategy and online exposure
- Google Ads, Meta Ads and TikTok Ads
- OTA media and online travel agency exposure, including BNSA and TravelAds where applicable
- Social media content and management
- E-commerce optimisation
- Branding
- Sales, marketing, revenue and reservation support

For service details, visit the [Hospio Solutions Services page](https://www.hospiosolutions.com/services.html).

## Target Industries and Markets

- Hotels
